bio: their IG bio, copied verbatim — do not paraphrase
about: what the show or business actually is, in their own framing
voice_notes: how they type — lowercase, formal, emoji-heavy, one-liners, voice notes
status: first_contact | building | green_light | soft_no | hard_no | active_client
needs: what they have said they need, or 'nothing stated yet'
offered: what Pronoy has already offered, or 'nothing yet'
commitments: anything Pronoy promised and has not delivered, or 'none'
full_thread: the whole DM thread, oldest first, prefixed 'them:' / 'pronoy:'
